name: TC-TXN-001 — Summary: Default period (last-7-days)
description:
Verifies the GET /summary?period=last-7-days endpoint.

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/transaction/summary
**Param:** period=last-7-days
**Expected:** HTTP 200 with total_volume, success_rate, total_refunds fields.

This validates the weekly aggregation used on the RMS dashboard.

**Note (RMSK-646):** `period=week` is not a valid API value (rejected with 400 "Invalid period value") — the accepted values are today|last-7-days|last-30-days|last-90-days|custom.
